page.overview:
Who is Baby Button Eyes?

Baby Button Eyes was a possessed killer doll who was not only homicidal herself, but also encouraged others to commit murder. She was featured in the horror movie The Re-Deadening, which was shown at Springfield Googolplex Theatres.
